lineas.texto: Part two. December starts hungry. Advent is a time of fasting: no meat for weeks.
Fish, beans, bread, and a lot of waiting.
Then Christmas comes, and it doesn't last one day. It lasts twelve.
Most work in the fields stops. It's the longest break of your whole year.
Your rent is due too. Many villagers owe the lord a hen at Christmas.
On some manors, the lord gives the tenants a Christmas dinner in return.
Bread, meat, ale, and music by the fire, in the middle of the darkest weeks.
Part three, {when_next}: the long, cold nights of January.
